name: Saddle Uptown
overview:
Get ready for a journey where the dust of the trail meets the neon glow of the big city. In Saddle Uptown, rugged country life gets a high-fashion makeover as a group of cowboys trades the heavy lifting of the ranch for the spotlight of a sophisticated urban stage.

In this NakedSword Original, directed by Raphaël Massicotte, we follow the transformation of men who—under the flash of the disco lights and the rhythm of modern beats—prove that the strength and charm of the "Old West" can be rediscovered in bold new ways. Amidst mirrored horses and daring style, they show that whether they’re on the range or in the city, they definitely know how to run the show.
